digest.component_or_area: store epoch guard and git merge coordination
propositions: A stale clone with mismatched epoch should refuse to union at sync._union_merge and return without merging, preserving both local and remote refs unchanged.
A stale clone with mismatched epoch should refuse to merge during push.py non-fast-forward retry, returning immediately without re-pushing and preserving both refs exactly.

The epoch field in .store-compat.json must be compared byte-for-byte as an opaque JSON string; equal epochs permit union, and any mismatch (present vs absent, different values, non-string types) triggers abort with distinct log messages.
The remote .store-compat.json must be read via git show of the remote ref; distinct error messages must distinguish file absence from ref unreadability.
A merely-behind clone with matching epochs must still converge via fast-forward adoption, and strictly-ahead clones must return early; neither convergence path is blocked by the epoch guard.

After a guard-aborted non-fast-forward push, fsck must report DIVERGED (not PUSH_PENDING), and local/remote commit tips remain byte-for-byte unchanged with zero merge invocations and zero further push attempts.
